# Acknowledgements (draft)

<!-- Generated by `Scripts/check-dependency-lock.py acknowledgements --write` from Docs/Licenses/inventory.json and the texts under Docs/Licenses/texts. Do not edit by hand; CI fails when this file differs from the output. -->

Draft of the third-party notices Sylvia must carry (plan 18.4 and Appendix C; ADR-0014). **Status: draft, agent-prepared; the release owner and counsel have not reviewed it, and no build shows it yet.** It covers the packages ADR-0014 recommends for each product and what they bring. The M0 builds link or bundle every component listed here (Docs/Stage0/evidence/M0-dependencies/linkage.log: the EPUB harness, the G0.2 transfer harness, the design catalog and, for GRDB, the G0.5 recovery package's iOS test bundle for the app; the G0.2 source service for the companion), except that no M0 iOS app links GRDB yet. M1 and M6 update it as the product targets take their packages. Entries marked Pending need a decision before any distribution (ADR-0014, open items).

## Sylvia for iPhone and iPad

Readium (EPUB), GRDB (persistence), Readium's ZIPFoundation (bundles and backups), SwiftASN1 (transfer pinning), Literata, and everything those bring into the app: the libraries Readium links, the code they vendor, and the fonts, styles and scripts in Readium's resource bundles.

### OpenDyslexic (font, in Readium's resources) 2.001

https://opendyslexic.org · Bitstream Vera license (original glyphs) and CC BY 3.0 Unported (OpenDyslexic changes), as stated in the font files

**Pending (not yet decided):** The fonts state: "Original Fonts are © Bitstream. OpenDyslexic changes and additional glyphs by Abelardo Gonzalez are licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported License. Based on a work at http://dyslexicfonts.com." The Bitstream license text they point to (http://opendyslexic.org/legal/) is no longer published there, and CC BY 3.0 section 4(a) forbids applying technological measures to the work; whether App Store distribution is compatible, and whether to ship these files at all, is for the product owner and counsel (ADR-0014).
